_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Constance Garnett (1861-1946) and her Russians. Each TITLE is its own work with its own slug; author sections (a Dostoevsky or Tolstoy section later) cross-reference these slugs, never a second copy. SOURCES are fetched by fetch_shelf.py; TITLES (one volume, or several joined) by split_shelf_titles.py. Rights: every title here was first published 1894-1927, so US public domain (published before 1931); UK public domain since 2017 (Garnett d. 1946). 'translated' = first publication of her translation; 'scan_edition' = the printing actually scanned when it is a later one. Gutenberg titles were checked for the PG Translator line (fetch report). No uids minted in the relay burst.

_pending.garnett-war-and-peace: Garnett's War and Peace (Heinemann 1904): the only scan found (bwb_P9-DUB-268) is a 1931+ Modern Library Giant. Pre-1931 IA War and Peace scans are other translators (Maude, Dole, Wiener). Removed 2026-10-02; a 1904 Heinemann or McClure scan would restore it.

_verified_note: Evidence that each source's rights/identity line was read (lane C review fix, 2026-10-02, pipeline run over the fetched files; no book text recorded). PG: the header's Translator: line and the COPYRIGHTED marker. IA: whether the translator's name appears in the first 30 KB of OCR, and the years printed in the first 15 KB of front matter (scanner/digitizer lines skipped). Any post-1930 year there was examined by eye; see the title's scan_edition.
